name: performance-load-runtime-proof
truth_boundary: This contract proves only hosted regression behavior observed on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu Docker Compose runner. It is not a production capacity benchmark, SLA/SLO guarantee, target-PC result, network-edge benchmark, or physical-hardware certification.

gateway_policy_context.benchmark_strategy: Use independent real authenticated principals for aggregate load; separately overload one principal to prove HTTP 429 enforcement.

checks.claim: Gateway actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
Identity-service actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
User-service actuator health reports UP before the load profiles.
Real authenticated API principals are created through the gateway and used for protected load.
Protected reads complete before timing and materialize the Redis users-list cache.
The configured multi-principal concurrent burst request set completes and is fully observed.
The configured multi-principal sustained authenticated read profile completes and is fully observed.
Each policy-compliant hosted profile stays at or below the conservative configured error-rate guardrail.
Each policy-compliant hosted profile stays at or below the conservative configured p95 latency guardrail.
Each policy-compliant hosted profile remains above the conservative configured throughput floor.
Raw p50, p95, p99 and max latency observations are recorded for every policy-compliant profile.
Gateway health continues reporting UP while the sustained profile is running.
A deliberate single-principal overload receives HTTP 429 while initial requests are still admitted.
Gateway, identity-service and user-service report UP after load and overload probing complete.
A protected gateway read succeeds after the load profiles complete.
The read-only benchmark leaves the protected user-list state unchanged after benchmark setup.
Evidence explicitly remains HOSTED_RUNTIME and makes no production-capacity or physical-PC claim.
